tool.name: Cline
tool.description: An autonomous coding agent for VS Code that can create and edit files, execute commands, use the browser, and more — with your permission at every step.

releases.name: v4.1.26
releases.body:
### Added

- Cloud tasks: Settings > API Configuration has a Local | Cloud toggle when cloud sessions are on. Cloud picks the Cline model new cloud tasks run on, saved separately from your local models. Clicking the model label in a cloud session's composer opens it there.
- Starting or resuming a cloud sandbox shows a progress card with the repo, branch and steps (start sandbox, clone repository, start agent). It collapses once the agent starts.

### Changed

- Cloud sessions hide the Plan/Act toggle and the auto-approve bar instead of showing them disabled.
- With no model chosen, the Cline provider uses Claude Sonnet 5.5 again, which is back at the top of Cline's recommended list.
- Model requests retry at most 3 times instead of 5.
- Kimi K3 now gets `max` reasoning for Extra High and Max, instead of an `xhigh` setting it rejects.
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the CommandCode, Reflection, Liquid Inference and Munito AI providers and drops CrofAI, iFlow and Llama. The Cline free list adds Reflection Beam, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and Laguna S 2.1 and drops Mimo V2.6 Flash and Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor. ClinePass now defaults to Kimi K3.1 Pro and adds MiniMax M3.1 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. Default models change for most other providers, mostly to Kimi K3.1 Pro, MiniMax M3.1 Flash or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. If you use a provider without pinning a model, expect a different default.

### Fixed

- GPT-6 models (such as `gpt-6-sol` and `gpt-6.1-sol`) work on OpenAI and Azure OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and SAP AI Core no longer rejects requests with "Unsupported parameter: 'max_tokens'". Both now get `max_completion_tokens`.
- Gemini API keys (the `gemini` provider) no longer send native Google Search. Free-tier keys failed every turn with a 429 quota error on Gemini 3+, and on Gemini 2.x every Cline tool was dropped.
- Toggling Plan/Act while a task is starting no longer drops your first prompt, and the session no longer keeps running with the other mode's tools.
- Disabled rules stay disabled.
- Starting a command no longer moves keyboard focus into the terminal, so text you're typing in the chat no longer lands in the shell.
- Cancelling a task or opening another one while Cline is asking a question no longer lets your next message get taken as the answer to the old question.
- A turn whose connection drops after the model has streamed only reasoning is now retried instead of ending the task.
- Auto-compaction no longer runs for models with an unknown context limit, and it no longer runs again every few tool calls after the first compaction.
- `ask_question`: the model keeps going after you pick an option, and empty answers are rejected.
- `run_commands` with an empty command list now returns an error instead of a silent success. On PowerShell, the tool tells the model how quote escaping works and to confirm recursive deletes first.
- Task header badges wrap instead of hiding the close button, the GitHub connection check no longer flashes a loading indicator, and the Local/Cloud toggle's padding is fixed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.25...v4.1.26

releases.name: SDK v0.2.0
releases.body:
- Starting a session that already has a run in progress now reattaches to the live session instead of replacing its runtime. Before, the original run kept going but couldn't be reached, and its transcript writes landed on a stale snapshot. A start that includes a prompt while a run is in progress is rejected
- The hub records every client that registered a capability for a session, including clients that join a task that's already running, and sends each request to the first one still connected. If none is left, the request fails quickly with a message the user can act on, instead of waiting forever
- A turn whose connection drops after the model has streamed only reasoning is now retried, and the partial reasoning is discarded. Turns with text, media or tool calls are still never retried
- Model requests retry at most 3 times after the first attempt (down from 5). Failed attempts are recorded in Langfuse traces, and cancelled requests are no longer reported as Langfuse errors
- AI SDK updated to `ai` 7.0.136 / `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 5.0.58. `max` reasoning now reaches the provider: the gateway no longer turns it into `xhigh`, and Kimi K3 gets `max` for Extra High and Max. Empty Anthropic turns are still retried despite the new `anthropic.*` custom stream parts
- The `gemini` provider no longer sends native Google Search. On Gemini 3+, free-tier keys failed every turn with a 429 quota error, and on Gemini 2.x it dropped every Cline tool. Vertex keeps native search
- Auto-compaction no longer runs when the model's input limit is unknown. Manual and overflow-recovery compaction still work
- After the first compaction, the size estimate now uses the messages as they are actually sent, with tool results truncated. Before, it overestimated about 7x and compaction ran again every few tool calls
- Checkpoint diffs read file contents with a single `git cat-file --batch` process instead of up to two `git show` processes per file. Workspaces with many untracked files used to spawn thousands of git processes
- SSH remotes work behind a ProxyJump alias. The connect budget goes from 10s to 30s, the per-command limit to 60s, and tunnel readiness to 40s. When ssh exits mid-upload, its real error is reported instead of `EPIPE`, and a `LocalForward` on the alias no longer collides with the tunnel
- `ask_question` answers are framed so the model keeps going after a bare choice. Empty answers are rejected, and an answer with only an attachment counts as answered
- `run_commands` rejects an empty `commands` list with a tool error, and its schema now advertises `minItems: 1`
- On PowerShell, the `run_commands` description explains backtick escaping, single-quoting literal paths, preferring cmdlets over `cmd /c`, and confirming recursive deletes first
- Plugin commands run in the active session runtime and the hub. Plugin watches start working again when discovery directories appear
- Compiled binaries load embedded plugin and dashboard resources straight from the binary, and every declared SDK runtime export is packaged
- A configured `CLINE_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_DIR` is resolved to an absolute path
- When OpenRouter has no match for a Cline recommended model, its capabilities are filled in from the Vercel catalog
- Desktop cloud session orchestration moved into the hub. `session.list` reports `activeCloudCommands`, and the hub isn't replaced while cloud commands are still running
- Core adds conversation summaries and cloud continuation support
- Run stall telemetry: `agent.run-finished` and `agent.run-failed` carry stall signals from a new `RunHealthObserver`
- `@cline/ui` now ships with the SDK packages on the shared version. It adds a `Kbd` component and token chips for slash commands and file mentions in `AgentComposer`
- Refreshed the model catalog (7,041 → 6,457 models). Adds the Liquid Inference, Munito AI and Munito AI (EU) providers and drops CrofAI, iFlow and Llama. The Cline free list adds Reflection Beam, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and Laguna S 2.1 and drops Mimo V2.6 Flash and Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor. ClinePass adds Kimi K3.1 Pro (now its default), MiniMax M3.1 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, and drops Mimo V2.5 and V2.5 Pro. Default models change for 56 other providers, mostly to Kimi K3.1 Pro, MiniMax M3.1 Flash or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.95...sdk/sdk/v0.2.0

releases.name: Desktop v0.0.49
releases.body:
- A new **Changes** button in the session header shows the session's line counts and opens a pane listing the files changed in the last turn or across the whole session, with a diff of each. When a turn finishes, a summary under it lists the files it changed; click it to open the pane on that turn
- A **project files panel** (folder button in the session header) shows a file tree beside the conversation, with a read-only tabbed viewer, git status letters, and a marker on files the session changed. Files the agent edited get a File/Diff toggle. Works on local and SSH environments
- An integrated **terminal panel** opens at the bottom of the window (toggle with Ctrl+backtick)
- Pull request status moved from the bar above the composer into a header button. Its menu shows the PR title, merge status and checks (failing checks first), and lets you open the PR on GitHub, create a PR, copy the branch name, or refresh
- A new **Local Models** settings page manages Ollama and LM Studio models: setup guidance, model details and storage, and a composer chip showing how much memory the loaded model uses
- **Keybindings** are configurable in Settings (also reachable from the app and Help menus). Quit can require holding the shortcut, 1 second by default on macOS, so it's harder to quit by accident
- Slash commands and `@file` mentions show as chips in the composer and in sent messages
- If the Hub fails to start, the app now shows a startup screen with Retry and Export diagnostics, instead of failing every action with "desktop backend endpoint not ready"
- General settings shows the Hub's status and has a Restart Hub button
- Opening a task that's already running in another Cline app now attaches to that run instead of starting a second one that couldn't be stopped. Requests that were waiting on an app that closed mid-task now fail with a clear message instead of hanging
- Sessions with a very large transcript (over about 8 MB) can be resumed again. Before, the transcript was sent to the Hub twice, which went over its message size limit
- Long lines in the file and diff viewers wrap, and rows always span the full width when scrolled
- New Cloud chats start on your local Cline or ClinePass model. If Cloud doesn't offer that model, ClinePass subscribers get a ClinePass model and everyone else gets Claude Sonnet 5.5
- A pasted Cline API key now replaces an old browser sign-in instead of being ignored. Provider settings fields stack properly in the narrow side panel
- The Sessions/Projects sort choice in the sidebar is remembered across restarts
- On Linux desktops without a tray (stock GNOME on Fedora or Debian), closing the window quits the app instead of leaving it running with no way to quit
- Internal messages meant only for the model no longer show in the transcript, and live session titles no longer show the raw `user_input` wrapper
- Schedule status stays current and failed runs show the full error
- Checking for changes no longer spawns thousands of git processes in workspaces with many untracked files
- SSH environments behind a ProxyJump alias now connect
- The update toast's Restart button sits under the message text
- A turn whose connection drops after the model has streamed only reasoning is now retried instead of ending the run
- Model requests retry at most 3 times instead of 5
- Kimi K3 now gets `max` reasoning for Extra High and Max, instead of an `xhigh` setting it rejects

- `ask_question`: the model keeps going after you pick an option, empty answers are rejected, and an answer with only an attachment counts
- `run_commands` with an empty command list now returns an error instead of a silent success. On PowerShell, the tool tells the model how quote escaping works and to confirm recursive deletes first
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the Liquid Inference and Munito AI providers and drops CrofAI, iFlow and Llama. The Cline free list adds Reflection Beam, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and Laguna S 2.1 and drops Mimo V2.6 Flash and Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor. ClinePass now defaults to Kimi K3.1 Pro and adds MiniMax M3.1 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. Default models change for 56 other providers, mostly to Kimi K3.1 Pro, MiniMax M3.1 Flash or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017

releases.name: SDK v0.0.95
releases.body:
- OpenAI-compatible requests for GPT-6 models (`gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6.1-sol`, `gpt-6-1-sol`, and later gpt-5 through gpt-9 ids) send `max_completion_tokens` instead of `max_tokens`, so OpenAI and Azure no longer reject them. Azure's `gpt-35-turbo` keeps `max_tokens`
- The hub daemon records which client started it (`CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_CLIENT`, `CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_VERSION`, `CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_TRANSPORT`) and publishes that as OTel resource attributes. SSH remote hubs report the local client with transport `ssh`. `@cline/shared` adds `withHubLauncherIdentity`, `claimHubLauncherIdentity` and `readHubLauncherIdentity`
- The telemetry self-check report includes `traces_exporter`
- Refreshed the model catalog (6,952 → 7,041 models). Adds the CommandCode and Reflection providers. The Cline recommended list leads with Claude Sonnet 5.5 again, so the `cline` provider's bundled default goes back to Claude Sonnet 5.5 from Gemini 4 Argon. Default models change for 302.AI (Gemini 4 Argon), Eden AI and Prime Inference (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave (Reflection Beam 1.0), NanoGPT, Pioneer (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), and Scaleway (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). OpenCode Go keeps its `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` base URL, now pinned, because models.dev moved its provider-level URL to an OpenAI-only path

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.94...sdk/sdk/v0.0.95

releases.name: v4.1.25
releases.body:
### Added

- Cline Cloud sessions, rolling out gradually: run a task in a hosted sandbox on a GitHub repo and branch you pick. Turn it on in Settings. Cloud tasks show in Recent and History with their status, notify you when they finish, and keep running after you close your editor.

### Changed

- With no model chosen, the Cline provider now uses Gemini 4 Argon, the new first model in Cline's recommended list. OpenRouter stays on Claude Sonnet 5.5.
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova. If you use one of those providers without pinning a model, expect a different default.

### Fixed

- Long requests to local models (LM Studio, Ollama) no longer fail after 5 minutes of silence with `terminated: BodyTimeoutError` while the server is still processing a large prompt.
- OpenAI Compatible base URLs are used exactly as entered. A host-only URL like `https://abc.com` used to get `/v1` added silently. Host-only URLs saved by earlier versions get `/v1` added once, so existing setups keep working.
- Images and files attached to an answer to one of Cline's questions now reach the model instead of being dropped.
- When a provider error interrupts a response mid-stream, Cline retries it up to 3 times before failing the turn.
- In JetBrains, the Run task card stays above the Auto-approve bar.
- Auto Compact and its strategy setting sit together again in Feature settings.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.24...v4.1.25

releases.name: SDK v0.0.94
releases.body:
- Plugins now run only in worker threads (the default, `CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=worker`) or in the subprocess sandbox (`sandbox`). The `in_process` mode is removed, along with its silent fallback. A host that ships no `plugin-sandbox-bootstrap.js` fails every plugin load with `PluginBootstrapMissingError`, which names `CLINE_PLUGIN_BOOTSTRAP_PATH`, instead of quietly running plugins inside the hub. The hub daemon's uncaught error handlers are fatal again. The SSH remote hub ships no bootstrap yet, so it reports plugin tools as missing
- Provider errors that arrive after a model stream has started are retried up to 3 times, and the final failure is reported as an error in logs and Langfuse traces. Exhausted retries no longer also trigger the agent's whole-turn retry, so retry budgets don't multiply
- Model request failure logs include the provider's request id
- `setHubDaemonLauncher` lets an embedding host start the hub daemon through a bundled Cline CLI, and `ensureDetachedHubServer` gains a `beforeSpawn` hook that runs only when a new daemon actually starts. The standalone SSH remote helper entrypoint is removed: SSH remotes run the hub through the uploaded Cline CLI
- `NodeHubClient` accepts `resolveConnectionHeaders`, so a remote proxy's WebSocket upgrade can be authenticated with HTTP headers refreshed on every reconnect. It is threaded through `HubRuntimeHost` and `RemoteRuntimeHost`
- `AskQuestionExecutor` may return text and image blocks, so attachments sent with an answer reach the model
- New `buildTelemetrySelfcheckReport` export in `@cline/shared`
- The `cline` provider's bundled default (the first Cline recommended model) is now Gemini 4 Argon instead of Claude Sonnet 5.5, because the recommended list now leads with it
- Refreshed the model catalog (6,862 → 6,952 models). Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.93...sdk/sdk/v0.0.94

releases.name: v4.1.24
releases.body:
### Changed

- With no model chosen, the Cline and OpenRouter providers now use Claude Sonnet 5.5. For Cline, that's the first model in Cline's recommended list.
- Selecting ai& shows its own API key and model picker, instead of the generic OpenAI-compatible form with base URL and custom headers.
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds Claude Haiku 5.5 and the AI/ML API, LowRouter, and Prime Inference providers. The Cline free list adds Step 5 Preview. The v0 provider now offers only its default model, `v0-1.5-md`, and OpenCode Go uses its new `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` endpoint. Default models change for 302.AI, Cortecs, CrossModel, DevPass, DigitalOcean, Eden AI, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Meta, Moark, NanoGPT, NEAR AI Cloud, Neuralwatt, Novita AI, Ofox, OpenCode Go, Requesty, Vivgrid, and a few others (most now Claude Haiku 5.5 or Muse Wonder 1.0). If you use one of those providers without pinning a model, expect a different default.

### Fixed

- Turning reasoning off no longer fails with a 400 error on GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Fable 5 or Claude Opus 5.5, and now works on every provider. Level-only Gemini models no longer reject the request with a thinking-budget error.
- An MCP server or hook that exits before reading all of its input no longer crashes the extension host about 3 seconds later.
- A 404 from a stale or retired model id is no longer shown as a sign-in problem. Cline shows the real error instead of the logged-out card.
- Errors in the Cline output log keep their details. Production builds used to drop them, so a line like "Cline OAuth login failed:" showed no reason.
- Deleting a slash command from the input keeps the spacing of the text around it.
- Screenshots and other images no longer inflate the token estimate, which made auto-compaction run long before the conversation was near its limit.
- Auto-compaction uses the selected model's context window when the catalog entry has none.
- Rule files that are symlinks now load, and skills in `.claude/skills` are now discovered.
- The editor tool no longer receives null in place of the text to replace from some models.
- Settings migrated from older versions no longer add an empty SAP AI Core provider.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.23...v4.1.24

releases.name: SDK v0.0.93
releases.body:
- Plugins load in-process through one registry per process instead of a node/bun subprocess, so the compiled CLI and its hub no longer need a runtime on PATH, and plugins can use the Bun global under the Bun-built hub. `CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=sandbox` keeps the subprocess sandbox. The registry wraps import, setup, hooks, tools and commands with timeouts and error capture, and tracks each plugin's state (loading/ready/degraded/failed/disabled) with its last error. A failing plugin no longer silently drops its tools: `session.create` accepts a `plugins` policy and returns `pluginIssues`, later failures reach affected sessions as status notices, the hub answers `plugins.list`/`plugins.status`/`plugins.reload` and broadcasts `plugin.status_changed`, and the daemon marks a plugin failed instead of shutting down when an uncaught error comes from it. Each session gets its own copy of every plugin module, so plugins that keep per-session state at module level keep working
- Turning reasoning off now works on every provider, not just a fixed list. Models whose catalog entry has no off option are sent nothing and keep their default, and models without a `reasoning` capability are skipped. Gemini and Vertex send exact `thinkingBudget` values only to models that advertise a budget; level-only Gemini models get a thinking level instead (they rejected `thinkingBudget`). A request never carries both the portable reasoning option and a native provider control (`effort`, `thinking`, `thinkingConfig`, …); the native one wins
- The `cline` provider's default model is the first entry of the Cline recommended-models list, falling back to `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`. `CLINE_DEFAULT_MODEL_ID` moves from Claude Sonnet 5 to Claude Sonnet 5.5, and the `openrouter` provider default is now `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` too
- `estimateRequestInputTokens` and `createTokenEstimator` no longer bill base64 image payloads at the text rate. A ~90 KB screenshot counted as ~30k tokens, so a few images triggered auto compaction long before the transcript was near budget. Each image now adds a flat `ESTIMATED_TOKENS_PER_IMAGE` (1600). New `createImageAwareReplacer` export in `@cline/shared`
- Auto compaction uses the resolved model's context window. When the discovered catalog entry had no limit but the selected-model override did, compaction was handed the bare catalog entry and ran against the wrong budget
- Scheduled runs: queued runs are claimed correctly under `bun:sqlite`, which bound the store's named parameters as NULL so the desktop hub never claimed a queued run and it stayed pending with no error. Runs whose agent turn ends with a provider error (such as a retired model id) are now recorded as failed with the error message instead of succeeding silently, and the run report keeps usage and tool calls. Queued cron occurrences superseded by a newer occurrence of the same schedule are cancelled, so a backlog no longer replays every missed slot back to back
- Rule files that are symlinks are now loaded from config directories instead of skipped. Edits to a link's target are picked up on the next refresh or new session
- `resolveSkillsConfigSearchPaths` scans `.claude/skills`, so skills authored for Claude Code are visible to Cline
- The editor tool advertises `old_text` as a plain string. When the schema allowed null, some models sent null instead of the replacement text. Null is still accepted at runtime and treated as omitted
- Composio connectors: signed-in sessions register Composio's meta tools (search, manage connections, wait for connections, multi-execute), so the agent can find connector tools across toolkits, hand the user a Connect Link for an app that is not connected yet, and run what it found. Connector tools are discovered through meta search; saved desktop connection state no longer supplies model tools. Hosts can supply their own authentication through the new `connectorsRequest` option (`ConnectorsRequest` exported from `@cline/core`), which is also forwarded to scheduled sessions. `resolveComposioToolsStatePath` is renamed to `resolveComposioConnectionStatePath`
- The Cline cloud sign-in helpers in `@cline/core` accept an `AbortSignal`, so hosts can cancel a pending sign-in while it is polling
- Cloud session refreshes update open sessions with titles renamed on the web, and keep renames made locally while a refresh is in flight
- Refreshed the model catalog (6,572 → 6,862 models). Adds the AI/ML API, LowRouter, and Prime Inference providers. models.dev no longer lists v0, so the `v0` provider ships with only its default model, `v0-1.5-md`. OpenCode Go's base URL moves from `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1` to `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1`. The Cline free list adds Step 5 Preview. Default models change for 302.AI, CrossModel, Cortecs, DigitalOcean, NEAR AI Cloud, and Ofox (Claude Haiku 5.5), DevPass (LLM Gateway), LLM Gateway, and Meta (Muse Wonder 1.0), Aixy (GPT-6.1 Sol), CloudFerro Sherlock and Moark (GLM 5.3), Ambient, NanoGPT, Neuralwatt, and Novita AI

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.92...sdk/sdk/v0.0.93

- Scheduled runs: queued runs now start instead of staying pending forever, a run whose model call fails (for example, a retired model) is marked failed with the error, and after downtime only the latest missed occurrence of a schedule runs instead of every one back to back

- Skills in `.claude/skills` are now discovered
- The editor tool no longer receives null in place of the text to replace from some models

The v0 provider now offers only its default model, `v0-1.5-md`, and OpenCode Go uses its new `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` endpoint. The Cline free list adds Step 5 Preview. Default models change for 302.AI, CrossModel, Cortecs, DigitalOcean, NEAR AI Cloud, and Ofox (Claude Haiku 5.5), DevPass (LLM Gateway), LLM Gateway, and Meta (Muse Wonder 1.0), Aixy (GPT-6.1 Sol), CloudFerro Sherlock and Moark (GLM 5.3), Ambient, NanoGPT, Neuralwatt, and Novita AI

releases.name: SDK v0.0.92
releases.body:
- The AI SDK moves together to one release line: `ai` 7.0.120 and every `@ai-sdk/*` package on `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 5.0.50 (previously `ai` 7.0.79 with packages bumped one by one). Turning reasoning off no longer sends `reasoning.effort: "none"` to OpenAI models that can't turn it off, such as GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol (GPT-6 Astra answered with a 400, for example from commit message generation); GPT-5.x and GPT-6 Sol/Luna still get `"none"`. Turning reasoning off also no longer sends `thinking: {type: "disabled"}` to Claude models that can't turn thinking off, such as Claude Fable 5 and Opus 5.5 (they answered with `"thinking.type.disabled" is not supported for this model`); other Claude models still get `disabled`
- Stdio MCP clients handle EPIPE when a server exits before reading all of its input. Previously that raised an uncaught exception on the host process. The SAP AI Core provider also no longer installs winston's process-wide `uncaughtException` handler, which called `process.exit(1)` three seconds after any uncaught error
- The legacy provider-settings migration no longer adds an empty `sapaicore` entry to `providers.json`. It used to do this for every migrated user, because the extension writes `sapAiCoreUseOrchestrationMode` as a default
- `@cline/core` exports `parseMcpHeaders`, used by the CLI's `mcp add` wizard to keep `--header` values
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds Claude Haiku 5.5. Default models change for Google Vertex AI (Claude Sonnet 5.5 → Claude Haiku 5.5), Cortecs, DevPass (LLM Gateway), Eden AI, GitHub Copilot, LLM Gateway, NanoGPT, OpenCode Go, Requesty, and Vivgrid (most now Claude Haiku 5.5)

releases.name: CLI v3.0.70
releases.body:
- Commit message generation and tasks with reasoning off no longer fail with a 400 error on GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Fable 5 or Claude Opus 5.5
- Cline no longer exits about 3 seconds after an MCP server or hook quits before reading all of its input

- Options that were accepted but never did anything are removed and now fail with "unknown option": `cline history --page`, and `cline schedule create`/`update` `--autonomous`, `--no-autonomous`, `--idle-timeout`, `--poll-interval` and `--delivery-channel`. Remove them from scripts. Existing schedules saved with them still load

Before, the schedule was saved and its results were silently never posted. Errors name the flag or `--metadata-json` path to fix

releases.name: v4.1.23
releases.body:
### Changed

- If a model's response ends without a recognized finish reason, Cline asks it to continue once instead of treating the response as complete.
- Refreshed the model catalog. The Cline recommended list adds GPT-6.1 Sol, and the free list adds Solar Mini 4 and drops DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and space-bunny-alpha. Default models change for 302.AI, AKI.IO, Blue Claw, CoralBricks, CrossModel, DevPass, DigitalOcean, GMI Cloud, LLM Gateway, Mistral, NanoGPT, Neon, Nvidia, Ofox, Requesty, Subconscious, The Grid AI, Vivgrid, and Vultr. Vultr's model ids were renamed upstream, so a pinned Vultr model may need to be re-selected. If you use one of those providers without pinning a model, expect a different default.

### Fixed

- **Generate Commit Message** now follows your `.clinerules`, so conventions like language, format, and ticket references apply to commit messages too.
- Claude through a custom Anthropic base URL (Azure AI Foundry, corporate gateways) no longer fails with a 400 error. 4.1.22 started sending an option only Anthropic's own API accepts.
- Kimi K3 and other models that only accept certain reasoning levels no longer reject requests. Cline picks the closest level the model supports.
- When an MCP tool returns more output than fits in context, Cline can now read the rest. It gets a preview plus a link it can page through with `read_files`, so the output past the cutoff is no longer lost.
- Approve and Reject on a tool approval work right away, even while the panel is still updating. A late update failure no longer rejects a later, unrelated approval.
- Old tasks no longer show leftover Focus Chain checklist rows when reopened.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.22...v4.1.23

releases.name: SDK v0.0.91
releases.body:
- Responses that end with a missing or unrecognized finish reason are no longer treated as successful completions. `AgentModelFinishReason` gains `unknown` (the AI SDK adapter maps unified `other` and missing reasons to it instead of `stop`). Without tool activity, the agent keeps the partial response and continues once with a hidden user message; a second unknown finish fails the run. Queued user messages are now consumed at every request boundary, including the first iteration
- Stdio MCP servers get a 10s default initialize budget (was 3s). `npx`/`uvx` launchers through cmd.exe on Windows routinely took 3-6s and were silently dropped from the session. An explicit `timeout` still overrides it
- The Anthropic provider sends the server-side refusal `fallbacks` option only to `api.anthropic.com`. Custom endpoints such as Azure AI Foundry rejected it with a 400. New `isOfficialAnthropicEndpoint` helper
- The portable reasoning level for the `cline` and `openai-compatible` adapters snaps to the model's advertised effort levels. Kimi K3 (low/high/max) was sent `medium` and `minimal`, which it rejects
- OpenAI-compatible providers (generic, `vercel-ai-gateway`, user-defined ids) write `providerOptions` under the camelCase alias only, which stops the per-chunk `providerOptions key 'openai-compatible'` deprecation warning from `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`
- New `apiKeyOptional` provider fact (`GatewayProviderMetadata.apiKeyOptional`, `resolveProviderApiKeyOptional`, `ProviderListItem.auth.apiKeyOptional`), declared on openai-compatible, ollama, lmstudio, litellm, vertex, bedrock, and user-added endpoints from `providers.json`/`models.json`
- Rules: new `listEnabledRulesFromRecords` / `loadRulesForSystemPromptFromRecords` exports. The combined user-instruction service now orders rules by name, matching the single-workspace path
- Opt-in Langfuse tracing for BYOK providers (`CLINE_LANGFUSE_ALL_PROVIDERS`), plus operator tags, metadata and environment via `CLINE_LANGFUSE_TAGS`, `CLINE_LANGFUSE_METADATA`, `LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENVIRONMENT`
- Hook discovery telemetry handles Windows path separators
- Refreshed the model catalog. The Cline free list adds Solar Mini 4 and drops DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and space-bunny-alpha. Adds the Engy provider. Default models change for AKI.IO, Blue Claw, CoralBricks, CrossModel (GPT-6.1 Sol), DevPass, LLM Gateway, Mistral, NanoGPT, Requesty (Mistral Large 4), Neon (Claude Opus 5.5), Subconscious, and The Grid AI

releases.name: SDK v0.0.90
releases.body:
- Agent teams no longer slow down as a session runs or while a teammate is streaming. Every streamed chunk and 2-second heartbeat used to re-save the whole team state, including every finished teammate's full transcript (one local `teams.db` reached 1.66 GB, with a single run row rewritten ~339k times). Stream chunks and heartbeats now go to live UIs only and are never persisted, only changed entities are written (batched into one transaction every ~300 ms), run records keep a summary instead of the transcript, and `team_events` is capped per team (2000 rows, 30 days). SQLite team storage moves to schema v2 with a one-time migration that compacts existing data; `SqliteTeamStore.vacuum()` returns the freed space when called explicitly. Failed team writes are retried instead of dropped
- Standalone provider requests made outside a session (such as commit message generation) can now resolve Cline surface headers. `sessionId` is optional in `resolveProviderRequestHeaders`, and `X-Task-ID` is omitted rather than sent empty
- Refreshed the model catalog. Default models change for DigitalOcean (GPT-6.1 Sol), GMI Cloud (Qwen 3.8 Flash), NanoGPT (Pareto 26.10 Preview), Nvidia (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash), and Ofox (GPT-6.1 Sol)

A new Cloud session waits until a model is ready before sending, and you can retry if the model list fails to load

releases.name: v4.1.22
releases.body:
### Added

- New providers: Bee (by HEOSSI) and Pareto Inference (`PARETO_API_KEY`).

### Changed

- Direct Anthropic requests now use Anthropic's server-side refusal fallback. On OpenRouter and Cline, Anthropic models can fail over to another upstream provider instead of failing the request.
- When a response is blocked by a content filter, Cline now says so and suggests rephrasing, instead of "Model returned empty response".
- Refreshed the model catalog. GPT-6.1 Sol becomes the default model for OpenAI, OpenRouter, GitHub Copilot, Cortecs, Eden AI, Kilo Gateway, both LLM Gateway providers, NanoGPT, OpenCode Zen, and Requesty. Vercel AI Gateway moves to Ling 3.1 Flash, Tempr Gateway to MiMo V2.6 Flash, CrossModel and Ofox to Claude Sonnet 5.5, Pioneer to GLiNER 2.5 Decide, and Scaleway to Qwen 3.8 27B. The Cline recommended list adds Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5. If you use one of those providers without pinning a model, expect a different default.

### Fixed

- After an API error you can type and send a new message instead of only using Retry. A `/compact` (or `/smol`, `/newtask`) typed during recovery stays in the composer instead of being sent to the model as text.
- If a new task fails Cline sign-in, signing in and submitting a revised prompt now starts the task with that prompt. Before, nothing happened.
- **Reset Code** is now disabled when a message has no checkpoint, and no longer stays disabled for a message whose checkpoint exists (seen on slow disks). Changing the Checkpoints setting now applies to the active task, and follow-up messages typed while it applies are kept in order.
- Canceling right after sending a message now stops the task. A cancel that landed while the turn was still being set up was ignored, and the task kept running.
- Reasoning tokens are no longer counted twice in token usage. Cost is unchanged.
- Amazon Bedrock: GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 route through inference profiles, and India regions (`ap-south-1`, `ap-south-2`) resolve the `in.` profile. OpenAI models behind inference profiles get the reasoning effort setting they support. Nova 2 Lite with high reasoning, application inference-profile ARNs, and Nova Micro no longer get requests Bedrock rejects. A legacy AWS profile setting saved without the "use profile" flag now carries over as profile authentication instead of being dropped.
- Gateway models on providers that mix endpoints keep their own API protocol instead of falling back to the provider-wide default.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.21...v4.1.22

releases.name: SDK v0.0.89
releases.body:
- Oversized MCP and Composio tool results can now be recovered in full. Core caches the oversized output in a per-session in-memory cache and sends the model a bounded preview plus a `cline://cache/...` URI that `read_files` can page through by line range. Custom tools can opt in with `resultPolicy: "cache-oversized"` on `createTool`. Entries expire after five model iterations without a read, the cache is capped at 16 MiB per session, and original output stays in history and tool events
- Custom providers from `providers.json`/`models.json` now run on the agent path. They appeared in pickers but failed with `Unknown or disabled provider "<id>"`, because `createAgentModelFromConfig` only registered builtin providers with the gateway. `@cline/llms` now exports `resolveGatewayProviderRegistration(Sync)`
- Provider settings saves are more robust. Settings still save when model discovery fails, mutations are serialized, a failed catalog write restores the previous settings, and persistence errors propagate to the caller (`saveLocalProviderSettings` is now async). Model source requests are authenticated, and source catalogs refresh when credentials or endpoints change
- Refreshed the model catalog. The Cline recommended list adds GPT-6.1 Sol and drops the Pixel Canary stealth model. Default models change for 302.AI (Claude Sonnet 5.5), NanoGPT (Ling 3.1 Flash), Vivgrid (GPT-6.1 Sol), and Vultr (MiMo V2.6 Flash RL). Vultr's model ids were renamed upstream (for example `zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8` is now `glm-5.2`), so a pinned Vultr model may need to be re-selected

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.88...sdk/sdk/v0.0.89

releases.name: SDK v0.0.88
releases.body:
- Direct Anthropic requests now ask the Claude API for its recommended server-side refusal fallback (`anthropic.fallbacks: "default"`), and OpenRouter and Cline requests for Anthropic models set `provider.allow_fallbacks` so a request can fail over to another upstream provider instead of failing outright
- A Stop issued while a turn is still being prepared is no longer dropped. The agent runtime ignores `abort()` with no run in flight, so a Stop that landed between `runTurn()` entry and the run start (session persistence, the git metadata refresh, credential sync) was lost and the turn kept running while the host showed it as stopped. `LocalRuntimeHost` now re-sends the abort once the run exists, and clears a leftover between-turns abort flag when a new turn starts so it can't cancel the next prompt
- Content-filtered turns are no longer reported as empty responses. `content-filter` is a new `AgentModelFinishReason`, mapped by both the AI SDK and ApiHandler adapters (including the compat round trip); the run fails with a message saying the response was blocked by a content filter and suggesting a rephrase, and the run-failed `sdk.error` event carries the turn's finish reason
- Resuming an existing session works again. 0.0.87 added a duplicate-start guard that rejected starting an existing session ID with "session already exists", which blocked desktop and TUI resume; the guard is reverted, and the cloud controller keeps initial thinking and reasoning-effort preferences in session metadata instead
- `NodeHubClient` registers `{ version, pid }` metadata (version defaults to the `@cline/core` version, overridable with `clientVersion`). `hub.client.registered` includes it, and the Cline Hub web app shows it for connected clients and in join/leave events
- `@ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock` moves to `^5.0.98`, so Nova 2 Lite with high reasoning effort no longer returns a 400
- Refreshed the model catalog. GPT-6.1 Sol becomes the default model for OpenAI, OpenRouter, GitHub Copilot, Cortecs, Eden AI, Kilo Gateway, both LLM Gateway providers, NanoGPT, OpenCode Zen, and Requesty. Vercel AI Gateway moves to Ling 3.1 Flash, Tempr Gateway to MiMo V2.6 Flash, CrossModel and Ofox to Claude Sonnet 5.5, Pioneer to GLiNER 2.5 Decide, and Scaleway to Qwen 3.8 27B. New models include Grok 4.7 on Bedrock, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Nebius, and Qwen 3.8 27B on Cerebras and Groq; the Claude Opus 4 variants are dropped

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.87...sdk/sdk/v0.0.88
